notes: The sheet does not say which kind of foundational cyberware this is (cyberarm, cyberleg, cybereye, and so on), so it is modeled as Internal Body Cyberware that takes no slot. Use it as a marker, and set Humanity Loss to 0 by hand on the options installed with it.
The sheet's cost is "Varies", so its price is 0 here.
Chipware: install it in a Chipware Socket.

The built-in Image Enhance is this item's own effect, the same as the core Image Enhance's (+2 to sight-based Perception, Lip Reading, and Conceal/Reveal Object, as toggles in the roll dialog). It uses none of the 3 Option Slots.
The built-in AudioVox is this item's own effects, the same as the core AudioVox's. It uses none of the 5 Option Slots.
The +2 to Athletics applies automatically while this is installed.
The +1 MOVE when paired with Syn-Lungs (Bontari Edition) is not automated: add it by hand when both are installed.

split.name: Daimler-Benz Nachtreiher Linear Frame (Internal)
notes: The internal frame. Sets BODY to 12 while installed, like the core's Implanted Linear Frame β. Requires two installations of Grafted Muscle & Bone Lace.

split.name: Daimler-Benz Nachtreiher Linear Frame (External)
notes: The external frame. Sets BODY to 12 while equipped, like the core's Linear Frame β. Requires two installations of Interface Plugs. It does not change HP or Death Saves; adjust those by hand.
The +2 to movement Stealth and to Melee Ambush attacks are toggles in the roll dialog.
The sheet gives its Humanity Loss as "NA" (it goes only in an FBC or ACPA), so it is 0 here.
Restoring HP is not automated.
The +1 INT applies automatically while this is installed. The maximum of 9 is not: a cap would also lower an INT above 9. The monthly 2d6 Humanity Loss is not automated.
The sheet does not give its slot cost, so it uses 1. The +1 WILL applies automatically while this is installed; do not install a second.

The sheet gives no cost, install, or Humanity Loss, so they are 0 and the core External Vidscreen's install (Hospital) here.
Invisibility to cameras and cybereyes is not automated.

split.name: Militech Fortress Popup Shield
notes: Install one in each arm (2 slots per arm). Equip the Militech Fortress Popup Shield (Shield) item when it is deployed.
